//: Declarations for this package alone, emitted where `backstage-cli package build` looks for
them. The root tsconfig compiles every workspace at once, which is what `yarn tsc` is for but
far more than packing one package needs — a consumer installing this package from git runs
prepack inside a container, where compiling the whole monorepo exhausts the default heap.
Paths in `compilerOptions` are inherited from the root config and stay relative to it, so
`outDir` and `rootDir` still resolve to the repo root.
